title: Go-to-market planning
description: Coordinate evidence-backed positioning, launch sequencing, copy/design assets, and commercial/technical readiness.
intent: Produce the requested GTM plan, draft assets, and readiness assessment from approved product facts. Planning does not authorize spend, outreach, publication, pricing changes, or deployment.

assignments.task: Establish target market, accepted product scope, resources, launch objective, constraints, and readiness criteria.
Gather current market, competitor, channel, and pricing evidence against the bounded brief.
Check capability truth, user problem, scope, onboarding, and acceptance gaps.
Inspect actual traction/baselines and define measurable outcomes; preserve unknowns.
assignments.when: Approved data is available or quantitative launch assumptions must be assessed.

assignments.task: Define evidence-backed audience, positioning, value propositions, objections, and message hierarchy.
Build launch sequencing, distribution/sales motion, pricing hypotheses, dependencies, and measurement from completed positioning.
Return requested launch/landing/email drafts using approved positioning and supported claims.
assignments.when: Copy assets are in the requested scope.

assignments.task: Assess or propose user-facing launch assets and onboarding flows against approved positioning.
assignments.when: The requested plan includes visual assets or user-facing launch flows.

assignments.task: Assess specified locale adaptations and terminology for the completed positioning brief.
assignments.when: The launch targets specified additional locales.

assignments.task: Check completed marketing, pricing, market, and projected-outcome claims; distinguish assumptions from observations.
Assess applicable technical artifact/deployment gates without releasing.
assignments.when: A software launch includes technical release readiness.

assignments.task: Assess search discovery readiness and site/content gaps.
assignments.when: Search discovery is material to the launch.

assignments.task: Assess available AI-answer visibility evidence and factual representation gaps.
assignments.when: AI-answer visibility is explicitly in launch scope.

completion: The plan and requested drafts reflect approved product facts, evidence, constraints, and ownership.
Commercial and technical readiness are separate, with unresolved gates and unverified metrics explicit.
No launch execution, publication, account change, or spend is inferred from planning.
